title: Smoked Trout Schmear
description: Chef John's smoked trout schmear is so easy and versatile. It's great spread on any kind of bread or crackers, but slathered atop a freshly toasted bagel may be its finest expression.
ingredients: 5 ounces smoked, boneless trout fillets, checked for bones and crumbled
1 teaspoon hot prepared horseradish, or more to taste
salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Place crumbled trout and softened cream cheese in a bowl. Add lemon juice, dill, chives, capers, horseradish, black pepper, salt, and cayenne pepper. Mix together with a fork until mixture achieves the chunkiness or creaminess you prefer. Transfer to a ramekin; wrap with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for 2 or 3 hours before serving to let flavors develop.

video.description: In this video, Chef John shows you how to make a creamy, smoky, and absolutely delicious schmear. The combination of cream cheese with smoked trout fillet is a classic. Spread it over pumpernickel bread slices or a toasted bagel. The schmear is flavored with capers, dill, and lemon juice. Be sure to refrigerate for a bit for all the flavors to blend together.
